newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Canberra rejects new airlines' route plans.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canberra rejects new airlines' route plans.

text.p: Australia's International Air Services Commission on Wednesday issued a draft decision rejecting the proposals of two airlines to fly to Greece, the Netherlands and Malaysia.

The commission said the business plans of new entrants Australian Connection Airlines and Australia World Airways had not provided sufficient evidence of appropriate financial arrangements or funds within a reasonable timeframe.
"In neither case are there fairly firm funding arrangements despite the length of time that both applicants have had to progress their funding," the commission said in a statement.

Australian Connection Airlines applied for capacity to Greece in January 1996 and Australia World Airways in February 1996. Australian Connection Airlines made a subsequent application for capacity to Malaysia and Australian World Airways for capacity to the Netherlands as part of a combined route.
